name: Kerala

demographics.note: All demographic values are Census 2011 and were verified as correct in this revision. literacyRate is stored as a fraction for state files (district files store percent) — literacyRatePercent is provided to avoid ambiguity. population_2026_projected is a projection, not a census count, and its derivation is not documented in this repo.

economy.perCapitaIncomeBasis: Per capita NSDP at current prices (2011-12 series)
economy.perCapitaGSDPNote: Per capita GSDP (Rs 3,17,723 for 2023-24) is a DIFFERENT and larger measure than per capita income / per capita NSDP (Rs 2,81,269). The previous value in this file, 316,612, was effectively the per capita GSDP figure mislabelled as per capita income.
economy.realPerCapitaGSDPNote: Kerala's real (constant-price) per capita GSDP was Rs 1,90,149 in 2024-25 per Economic Review 2025 — do not mix with current-price figures.
economy.gsdpCompositionNote: Broad sectoral GVA shares at state level from the MoSPI/StatisticsTimes compilation. Not to be applied to individual districts.

hdiNote: Global Data Lab Subnational HDI (2022). Kerala consistently ranks first or near-first among Indian states on HDI. Kerala does not publish a district-level HDI series comparable to Karnataka's SHDR, so district files for Kerala may legitimately have no HDI value.
